predictions: Well, crap… that was my worst week of the season. We dumped another match to forfeit (that's two in two weeks!), and then I dropped a pretty paltry 14-11 record on the matches that were played. That is kinda sad, even despite the fact that 8 of the 11 losses would have tied or flipped on one dart. That brings me to 207-103 (66.8% correct) for the season, and I'm on a down slide. Ugh. While I've hit a couple wins for my worst picks, I've slowed with a few others, and now I have FIVE teams sitting so much worse (4-8 each) than everybody else.

Match of the week: (B Div.) Hump Day! @ Dart Attack. With Wing's loss last week, the B race is back on. Which very immediately makes this an elimination match (and at least a determination match of who will finish in the top two). Hump Day won this pairing last time around, but Attack has been a hot 4-1 since then. This is going to be a good one, but I feel like that Attack roll might just continue onward, 13-11.

Match #2: (A Div.) Element W @ Dart Vader. Element has a pretty decent advantage right now, but with both Vader and Show Me on the docket to finish things, the A race is still very much alive. This is round 5 of the 6 head-to-head matchups among the league's three behemoths, and this will be predictably tight again. Element, 13-11.

Match #3: (E Div.) Ton 80 Proof @ Dartifacts. Ton 80 will need some help from the Corkers in week 14 to be able to overtake the Dartifacts for the E crown, but their first step would have to be to take care of their own business here. They won this matchup last time, but it just feels like the Dartifacts have upped it a gear since then. 'Facts, 14-10.

Match #4: (G Div.) She-nanigans @ Flight Club. Flight Club has recently just sort of found themselves alone atop G, and now all they have to do is win two matches (or even win one and score a lot, like 11 or 12, in a loss) to take the G title. The She-nanigans are certainly their biggest hurdle, so if they can get past this one… Flight Club, 14-10.

Matches #5 & #6: (D Div.) Lonerider @ Main Street Mayhem; That's What She Said @ Duck Fook. D division has been reduced to a race for 2nd between Mayhem and the Ducks. On paper, it looks like they both should advance through this week, but none of these are gimmes (heck, the Ducks only won this matchup by 13-11 last time). I feel like they will both handle their business though. Mayhem plods through a very game Lonerider, 14-10; and Ducks get theirs, 15-9.

Match #7: (B Div.) Wing & a Plaque @ Darty Little Secrets. With a week 14 bye, this is Wing's last task. A win here clinches B, while a loss very possibly means they will be passed by the winner of the match of the week. Wing's DCkt dominance reigns supreme, 14-10.

Match #8: (A Div.) Inconsistent Consistently @ The Outlaws. My favorite thing that has happened this season is that teams in A have grasped how completely bad-ass it is to say that you're one of the RDL's top four teams. Inconsistent basically locks that in, 15-9.
Match #9: (C Div.) Rif Raf @ Shooter McGavin. Seems like a pretty simple story line here… loser likely finishes in a bottom-two spot, and probably drops to D in the spring. McGavin in 1001 (again!).
Match #10: (E Div.) Red-eye Rangers @ Aim For Fame. With their point advantage on Rippin, this is Fame's shot at climbing out of a bottom-2 finish. How are the Rangers 2-9?! I'll take Red-eye, 13-11.
Match #11: (D Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ One Dart Wonders. Outside shot at 2nd for Menace still? Almost certainly not, but definitely not if they drop this one. Menace gets through, 14-10.
Match #12: (G Div.) Double Vision @ Throwin' on the Bayou. Is this the most important match of the season? One head-to-head to avoid 'that spot'. This is going to be excellent drama. Bayou, 13-11.
